evals.name: lab-from-handout-and-screenshots
evals.prompt: сделай отчет по 14 лабе по облачным технологиям. методичка и скрины лежат в CloudTech/lab-14
evals.expected_output: CloudTech/lab-14/main.tex on suai-report with the title page from lab-13, tasks from the handout, all 18 screenshots captioned by content and referenced in the text; a built CloudTech-lab-14.pdf
assertions: CloudTech-lab-14.pdf is built next to main.tex
check_report.py reports no errors
Every figure and table is referenced in the text
All 18 screenshots from images/ are inserted
Title page taken from lab-13: teacher Д. С. Лисюков, course «Облачные технологии и сервисы», number 14
No manual figure/tabular/itemize/lstlisting
\suaitasks has at least 3 tasks
The report text is in Russian
